from bubble_sort import bubbleSort, bubble_sort

def test_bubble_sort_sorts_values_in_place() -> None:
    values = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]

    result = bubble_sort(values)

    assert result is None
    assert values == [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]

    values = [1, 2, 3]

    bubble_sort(values)

    assert values == [1, 2, 3]

    values = [3, 1, 2]

    result = bubbleSort(values)

    assert result is None
    assert values == [1, 2, 3]

    assert legacy_bubble_sort is bubble_sort
